sourceFacts.fact: Household members and close contacts should be treated at the same time as the infected person.
Close contact allows spread and reinfestation.
Used clothing and bedding also need appropriate cleaning.

nodes.shape: matching four bust icons each with teal treatment check
nodes.label: Treat close contacts together

nodes.shape: folded fabric and a small washing symbol
nodes.label: Clean used clothing and bedding

former contact arrows pale and interrupted to indicate reduced reinfestation risk

checks: Each network has four icons; left has only one check while right has four.
Left transmission loop closes and right transmission loop is visibly interrupted.
No mites, skin or tissue anatomy; no depiction of someone being unsafe by touching a treated person.
The cleaning reminder is supplementary; no unsupported time or dose instructions.
validation.pixelReviewNotes: Compared full pixels against specification: both networks have four people; left has one treatment check and a complete clockwise loop; right has four checks and visibly interrupted paths plus a broken ring. No internal anatomy or skin pathology. Cleaning reminder matches CDC. Simultaneous treatment coverage is the clear visual distinction.
